author: National Geographic
description:
On August 5, 2010, a catastrophic cave-in trapped 33 miners 2,300 feet (700 meters) beneath the surface in northern Chile. In the first full episode of Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time ("Buried Alive"), watch as international rescue teams work around the clock against shrinking odds to make contact with the men buried under solid rock. 

As rescuers race to save the trapped miners, an extraordinary discovery transforms a desperate search into a hopeful mission. Explore the cutting-edge engineering, extreme physiological endurance, and human resilience that make the Chilean Mine Rescue one of the most captivating disaster survival stories.
